title: Engagement State
description: Single source of truth for a /engagement run, written to engagement-state.json in the working directory and updated by the orchestrating conversation as phases complete.

client.description: Client name or 'internal' for self-directed work

question.description: The precise governing question this engagement answers

workstreams.description: MECE workstreams the engagement is decomposed into

owner.description: Specialist agent that owns this workstream

inputs.description: Files or upstream deliverable paths this workstream consumes

deliverable.description: Path to this workstream's output file

findings_summary.description: One-line summary of key findings; empty until the workstream is approved

dependencies.description: Workstream ids that must complete before this one starts

iterations.description: Number of quality-gate revision cycles used (max 3 before escalation)

decisions.description: Decisions requiring Consultant input, stated as questions with options

open_risks.description: Unresolved risks surfaced by any workstream or the quality gate
